description: Fork of exp760 (E=192 d_v=32 hard 24K eff bs=48 = 1.2048 @ 176M). Apply the exp755->exp760 trick at the tph knob: halve ALL tphs (qkv/v 256->128, out 512->256, residual 256->128, emb_resid 256->128) -> 97.5M params and ~0.4 s/step at eff bs=48 (-44.7% wall per step). Reinvest saved compute via DOUBLED EFFECTIVE BATCH: eff bs 48 -> 96 (phys 48 * grad_accum 2). Same n_steps=24K as exp760 -> 2x total tokens (590M -> 1.18B) at matched step count for clean comparison. NAPs unchanged from exp760 (qkv=4, v=6, out=7, resid=6, emb_resid=6). Same recipe: hard + dense_K + bf16 storage + fp32 master Lion + global clip(1.0). Tests whether tph-halving + 2x batch (instead of 2x steps as in exp763 plan) gives the cleanest comparison vs exp760.
